description: This file defines a template class 'SingleClientServer' for managing a WebSocket server that handles a single client connection, including methods to start and stop the server, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: SingleClientServer
classes.description: A template class for a WebSocket server managing a single client connection, providing start and stop functionalities.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket server on a specified port, setting up connection callbacks and handling errors.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket server listening for new connections and closes existing connections, with logging.
